items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Petrillo had everybody closed up back in those days.

ctx.x: Well I don’t know. We walked up many, many flights of steps to the studio. Petrillo had everybody closed up back in those days.
So those particular recordings you made that day, they probably weren’t released until after the strike was over.
